text_block_list.text:
Even though it had grown dark, the sounds 
of practice were still echoing from the 
dance studio.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gaaaaah! I just can't dig deep when it 
really counts, can I?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
When I watch Opera-senpai dance, her moves 
are so sharp and cool, but...

Watching Vodka move, it looks like she's 
focusing too much on her upper body.
choice_data_list:
I think you're focusing too much on your 
upper body.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, it's just you, Trainer. Don't 
scare me like that."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, I'm focusing too much on 
my upper body?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Dancing is all about nailing it with your 
expressions and arm movements, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—!? Oh, right! When you drop your bike at 
a standstill, you gotta sort out your 
footing first.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I see, if the footing is unsteady, you 
can't make a clean snap...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Do you know any workouts for training 
the lower body?
choice_data_list: How about a fitness bike or something?
Distance running would probably be best.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
An exercise bike...? Oh, the ones they 
have at the gym.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that just a regular bicycle? Does it 
really do anything?

Vodka hadn't seemed very keen on the idea, 
but the next morning—

Voices can be heard coming from inside the 
gym.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Vroom, vroom...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
From right here! I'm gonna show ya my 
cornering technique, pushin' it right to 
the absolute limit.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, with half-baked guts, you won't be 
able to keep up with my running, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wha! Wh-What are you doing in a place like 
that?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're the one who told me to try out 
the exercise bike, aren't you?! That's 
why—
choice_data_list:
I can hear a vroom, vroom sound right 
now...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Didn't you mishear something!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Look, if you're just gonna get in the way 
of training, get out!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Good grief, can't let my guard 
down for a second. Time to pull myself 
together—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time to tear up the mountain pass 
one more time!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what're you peeping for?! 
I-I-I-I... I told you to get out, didn't 
I?!

I wanted to see Vodka's high-spirited 
mountain pass driving technique, but 
having been kicked out, there's nothing I 
can do...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Distance running...? Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Joggin' around like a snail ain't gonna do 
squat, right? I'm gonna do things my way.

And the next morning—Vodka was seen 
running on the training course.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

Vodka's movements seem more sluggish than 
usual.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Phew... What's wrong? You're making a 
funny face.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ah, you think my movements look off?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh, hold on a sec.
(Clatter)

A rather heavy weight came crashing down 
at Vodka's feet.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I saw a martial artist wearing it 
on a shopping channel a while back and 
thought it looked so cool, so I bought it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's quite a heavy load, but if I wear it 
under my jersey, you can't tell at all, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So today, I think I'll wear this all day 
long.

It might have made for good training, but 
for the rest of the day, Vodka's movements 
were stiff as a robot.
